newsitem.title: USA: Gillette names Oral-B, Braun unit presidents.
newsitem.headline: Gillette names Oral-B, Braun unit presidents.

text.p: Gillette Co said Wednesday it had named A. Bruce Cleverly as president of its Oral-B Laboratories unit, and Philip Hung as president of its Braun Inc unit as well as group general manager of Braun North America.
Cleverly, who will head the global operations of Oral-B toothbrush company, succeeds Jorgen Wedel, who was named executive vice president of Gillette International Group.
Oral-B Laboratories is based in Belmont, Calif., the company said.
Hung is replacing Cleverly as Braun president manager of its North America subsidiary. He most recently was executive director of Braun International affiliated markets based in Kronberg, Germany.
Braun, which makes personal care and household products, is based in Woburn, Mass., Gillette said.
